title: Ubupfu bw'ugushaka ubukuru
intro: Mugende mu rugendo rwo guhishura akaranga k’ishirahamwe ry’abantu bose imigambi yaryo y’ubushizi bw’amanga yashitse ku mpera itategerezwa kandi ikomeye. Iyi nkuru irakora nk’icibutso gikomeye c’ububasha bw’Imana n’ubugoyagoye bw’ububasha bw’isi iyo burwanya ivyeranda. Mumenyeshe akabanga k’iri tsinda, inkuru yaryo yanditswe muri Korowani nk’imburi ku barondera bose kurenga amategeko.
clues: Twarafise icipfuzo gikomeye, twizera ko ububasha bwacu butagira uko bungana, maze dufata urugendo dufise intumbero itomoye kandi yo gusenyura.
Umurongozi wacu, yuzuye ubwibone, yararondeye guhumanya Inzu nyeranda yubahwa na benshi, afise intumbero yo guhindura urugendo rwo gusenga akaja ku nyubakwa twubatse.
Twavuye mu gihugu ca kure, twagendana n’ingabo nyinshi cane, twizigiye ko twoshobora gusenya iyo nyubakwa ya kera yari mu Gisagara Ceranda.
Ingabo zacu zari ziteye ubwoba, zirongowe n’ibiremwa biteye igomwe, ivyo bikaba ari ibintu bidasanzwe, nimba vyari vyigeze, biboneka mu ntambara nk’iyo n’ababa mu gihugu twateye.
Twashitse aho twari tuja, habayeho ubufasha bw’Imana; haraboneka ibiremwa bitobito bifise amababa, bidutera amabuye y’ibumba ry’umuriro.
Urugendo rwacu rwose rwarangiriye mu buryo buteye ubwoba, dusiga inguvu zacu ziteye ubwoba zizimangana burundu, nk’ivyatsi vyataguwe, umugambi wacu munini uhinduka inkungugu.
arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verse: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? (105:1)
